name: what solo travel taught me that university didn't

music.title: Wings (feat. sped up nightcore) [Sped Up Version]

lines.ref:
what solo travel taught me
that university didn't

how to enjoy my
own company

how to be respectful
of others

how to pause and
be present

shots.brief: smiling selfie on scenic outdoor transit or boat (ref: Young man smiling holding camera on a boat passing through a foggy river gorge canyon; selfie)
walking away solo in an open scenic location (ref: Man walking alone along the beach towards the water with hands behind his head; tripod)
dancing or joking around candidly with a friend (ref: Man wearing a helmet doing a synchronized funny dance with a local friend outdoors; tripod)
eating a quick snack or street food, selfie (ref: Shirtless man with a cap eating an onigiri snack outdoors by the coast; selfie)
running or walking through rain/chaotic weather laughing (ref: Man wearing makeshift plastic wrap poncho laughing while running in pouring rain at night; filmed by friend)
walking away down stairs or trail toward an expansive scenic view (ref: Man walking down scenic steps into a lush green mountain valley panorama; filmed by friend)
tired, stressed, or relieved reaction selfie after a tough situation (ref: Man in a blue raincoat looking exhausted and smiling wryly with hand on head; selfie)
looking up in awe at an architectural monument or tall city landmark (ref: Man standing in front of an ancient historical temple, looking up and shielding eyes from the sun; filmed by friend)

audit.notes: Adapt the hook to any life transition or pursuit (e.g., 'what moving to NYC taught me that university didn't' or 'what freelancing taught me'). Pair snappy lessons with standard city b-roll: subway rides, rainy night runs, eating bodega food, working in cafes, and looking up at skyscrapers.
audit.summary: A fast-cut montage of travel b-roll clips showcasing life lessons learned from solo travel that university failed to teach.
